query:
SELECT 
  fe.sessionId,
  COALESCE(fe.adName, qs.adName) as adName,
  COALESCE(fe.alertTier, qs.alertTier) as alertTier,
  qs.fullName,
  qs.email
FROM funnel_events fe
LEFT JOIN quiz_submissions qs ON fe.sessionId = qs.sessionId
WHERE fe.eventType = 'order_click'
ORDER BY fe.eventTimestamp DESC;
